tasks.label: ТВОЯ РОЛЬ
tasks.q: Сусідка тітки Петунії зламала ногу, тож Гаррі вперше беруть у зоопарк. Ти теж там зі своєю родиною і випадково опиняєшся в тераріумі поруч із Гаррі. Те, що станеться далі, ти не забудеш ніколи.
tasks.q_pl: Sąsiadka ciotki Petunii złamała nogę, więc Harry pierwszy raz jedzie do zoo. Ty też tam jesteś z rodziną i przypadkiem trafiasz do terrarium obok Harry'ego. Tego, co się stanie, nie zapomnisz nigdy.
tasks.q_en: Aunt Petunia's neighbour has broken her leg, so for the first time Harry is taken to the zoo. You're there with your family too, and you happen to end up in the reptile house next to Harry. You'll never forget what happens next.

The boy asked whether it missed ____.

Suddenly the fat boy pushed the thin one aside and pressed against the ____.
And in that very second the glass ____.
The fat boy ____ into the water with a splash.
The snake calmly ____ while people screamed and ran for the exit.
When the glass came back, the boy was ____.
His father was ____ and was staring at the thin boy.
I still don't know what happened. But it definitely wasn't an accident.
